question: Why does Bhairava commend the goddess for asking about a matter rare even for gods?
premises: The great goddess has asked a question
The matter asked about is hard to obtain even for the gods
inference: Bhairava commends the goddess because she has asked about a matter rare even for the gods.
plain_english: Well said, well said, O great goddess; you have asked me about something hard to obtain even for the gods.
